note: Henry Schein spun off Covetrus: 0.4 per share (Henry Schein release). Covetrus' first regular-way day; S&P moved it to the MidCap 400 before the 2019-02-11 open (S&P DJI 2019-02-05), so it left the S&P 500 at that first close. Closes: Tiingo raw; Nasdaq agrees on the ex-date.

GE Transportation spun off and merged into Wabtec: 0.005371 Wabtec per GE share (GE release 2019-02-25). GE closes from Tiingo raw; Wabtec close = Tiingo = Nasdaq. Wabtec joined the S&P 500 on 2019-02-27.

FMC distributed its Livent stake: 0.935301 Livent per FMC share (FMC 8-K 2019-03-01). Livent moved to the SmallCap 600 before the 2019-03-05 open (S&P DJI 2019-02-26). FMC closes: Tiingo raw = Nasdaq on the ex-date.
21st Century Fox Class B, same terms (1/3 Fox Corp Class B).

21st Century Fox (Class A) before Disney bought it: on 2019-03-19 0.263183 of each share was exchanged for 1/3 Fox Corp Class A share and holders kept 0.736817 shares, which became Disney consideration the next day (Disney/21CF release 2019-03-19). TFCFA closes from Tiingo; its 49.69 = 0.4517 x Disney's 110.00 close. S&P added Fox Corp before the 3/19 open and removed 21CF before the 3/20 open (S&P DJI 2019-03-14).
DowDuPont spun off Dow Inc.: 1 per 3 shares. Dow's first regular-way day; it replaced Brighthouse in the S&P 500 the same day. DowDuPont closes: Tiingo raw; Dow close = Tiingo = Nasdaq.
V.F. spun off Kontoor Brands: 1 per 7 shares. Kontoor moved to the SmallCap 600 before the 2019-05-24 open (S&P DJI 2019-05-20). Closes: Tiingo raw = Nasdaq on the ex-date.

DowDuPont spun off Corteva (1 per 3 shares) and then did a 1-for-3 reverse split, both on 2019-06-01 (DuPont Form 8937): each old share became 1/3 DuPont + 1/3 Corteva. DuPont's 76.10 close (= that day's high) is the same at Tiingo and Nasdaq; the 8937's June 4 high-low averages ($74.94, $26.15) match our June 4 bars.

Ingersoll-Rand plc (now TT) spun its industrial arm into Gardner Denver (renamed Ingersoll Rand Inc., IR): 1 HoldCo share per share x 0.8824 merger ratio (Trane Form 8937). Closes: Tiingo raw, Nasdaq agrees on both ex-date closes.

Arconic Inc. (now Howmet, HWM) spun off Arconic Corp: 1 share per 4 (Arconic Corp information statement). Arconic Corp sat in the S&P 500 at zero price from the 2020-03-31 close until it moved to the SmallCap 600 before the 2020-04-06 open (S&P DJI 2020-04-01).
United Technologies (now RTX) spun off Carrier (1 per share) and Otis (0.5 per share) the day it merged with Raytheon. UTX close 2020-04-02 from Tiingo raw; ex-date closes agree Tiingo = Nasdaq.
Fortive spun off Vontier: 0.4 per share (Fortive kept 19.9%). Vontier close 28.11 = Tiingo = Nasdaq (Yahoo's 28.28 is patched, see price_patches.csv).

Pfizer spun off Upjohn, which merged with Mylan to form Viatris the same day: ~0.124079 Viatris per Pfizer share (Pfizer release 2020-11-16); Viatris' first regular-way day and Pfizer's ex-date 2020-11-17.
Aimco spun off Apartment Income REIT 1:1 (AIR 8-K 2020-12-15). S&P: AIRC sat in the S&P 500 until it moved to the MidCap 400 before the 2020-12-21 open, when Tesla replaced AIV (S&P DJI 2020-12-11).
